toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
What is going on: most of the Q3 pipeline growth is not real. On 29 Sept, 212 partner-tagged records ($6.2M) were bulk-loaded under Jun Okafor's account from a file that arrived in a team chat with the note "load before snapshot." None had any logged activity, and 171 of them duplicate 2024 closed-lost deals with dates moved into Q4. Rep-created deals convert at a steady 25%, the same as earlier this year, so the four reps are not failing to close. The webinar did not drive the surge.

How sure: high that the import is the main cause and that the reps' conversion is normal. Less sure who prepared and requested the file. Dana Wexley denies it, and the chat messages are gone.

Next steps: Do not sign the performance plans or release the requisitions. Restate coverage using rep-created deals only (about 1.9x, below the 3.0x gate). Quarantine the 212 records. Preserve the source file and import job record, and interview Okafor and channel members about who posted the file.
